verdict.rationale: Statsig documents official client and server SDKs that evaluate locally, and states that evaluation is deterministic, returning the same result across client and server platforms. Web coverage is shown through the JavaScript SDK and the React StatsigProvider, and server SDKs are referenced. Mobile SDKs are not explicitly evidenced: the tutorial only targets mobile platforms with a gate rule, which is not a mobile SDK. missing for 10: explicit documentation of official mobile (iOS/Android/React Native) SDKs, a full SDK language list, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform consistency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official SDKs across my whole stack — backend, web, and mobile — with consistent flag behavior

citations.quote: Given the same user object and the same state of the experiment or feature gate, Statsig always returns the same result, even across different platforms (client or server).
After initialization, both Client and Server SDKs evaluate experiments/gates _without a network request_, and typically in less than 1ms.
